title: Clone risk action gated only on `risk.read` — no `risk.write`/`risk.create` check; no classification warning for Restricted/Confidential risks
description: Clone risk action button only checks `risk.read` permission. No `risk.write` or `risk.create` guard. No warning when cloning a `Restricted` or `Confidential` risk that the clone will inherit the same classification.

title: `getRiskColor` maps score < 5 and score 5–9 to identical green — no "Very Low" zone; negligible risks indistinguishable from Low
description: `getRiskColor` maps both `score < 5` and `score 5–9` to green. There is no "Very Low" zone. Negligible risks (score 1–4) are visually identical to Low risks (score 5–9).

title: `reviewCadence = Math.max(0, 100 − reviewDue × 10)` penalises large organisations disproportionately — flat 0% for ≥ 10 overdue reviews
description: `reviewCadence = Math.max(0, 100 − reviewDue × 10)` — any organisation with 10+ overdue reviews scores 0% regardless of total risk count. A 500-risk org with 10 overdue is penalised identically to a 20-risk org with 10 overdue.

title: Prediction factor strings not linked to source data — `riskId` exists but no UI link; auditor cannot verify basis for AI-generated predictions
description: Prediction factor strings contain a `riskId` reference but no clickable UI link. Auditors cannot navigate from a prediction to the underlying risk record that generated it.

title: No year-over-year comparison — single time-window only; auditor cannot demonstrate continual improvement per ISO cl. 10.1
description: Trends page supports only a single time-window selection. No option to overlay a prior period or compare current year vs. prior year risk counts/scores.

title: No staleness indicator on triage items — queue may contain findings from a 6-week-old Prowler scan that are already remediated
description: Triage queue items from Prowler, VendorService, etc. show no `lastScanAt` or age indicator. A finding from a 6-week-old Prowler scan that has since been remediated appears identical to a fresh finding.

title: AI-returned `likelihood` and `impact` stored as-is without bounds clamping — out-of-range values (0 or 6) produce invalid score (0 or 30)
description: AI-returned `likelihood` and `impact` values stored as-is. Out-of-range values (0 or 6+) produce invalid scores (0 or 30+) that fall outside the 5×5 heat map grid, causing rendering errors or misplacement.

title: No self-acceptance prevention — risk owner can select themselves as approver; four-eyes principle not enforced
description: The approver dropdown is not filtered to exclude the risk owner or creator. Risk owners can select themselves as the approver for their own risk acceptance.

title: Treatment description has no minimum length — trivial entries (`TBD`, `see ticket`) accepted as documented treatment evidence
description: Treatment description input has no minimum length validation. Entries like `TBD` or `see ticket` are accepted as documented treatment evidence.

title: `submitAcceptanceRequest` stores `email: ''` and `name: ''` for all approvers — acceptance audit trail contains no human-readable approver identity beyond `ObjectId`
description: In `submitAcceptanceRequest`, approvers are constructed as `data.approverIds.map((id) => ({ userId: new ObjectId(id), email: '', name: '' }))`. No user lookup is performed to populate `email` and `name`. All acceptance records in the database store blank string identity for every approver — only `userId` (ObjectId) is preserved.

title: `AcceptanceRequestSchema` enforces `justification: z.string().min(1)` — server-side accepts single-char justification; 50-char advisory is frontend-only
description: `AcceptanceRequestSchema` defines `justification: z.string().min(1).max(2000)`. The frontend shows an advisory hint of 50 characters minimum, but the backend schema accepts any non-empty string. A one-character justification (`x`) passes Zod validation and is persisted as a documented risk acceptance rationale. `RenewalRequestSchema` has the same gap: `justification: z.string().min(1).max(2000)`.

title: `getTrends` `$group` stage groups by month only, not month+year — data from different years collapses into the same bucket
`riskReduction` NaN when inherentRiskScore = 0 — already guarded with `inherentRiskScore > 0 ? ... : 0` at line ~840
`new Date(acceptance?.expiryDate).toLocaleDateString()` passes null to `Date()` — displays 1970-01-01 epoch instead of "No expiry set"
Expiry notifier uses stale risk title snapshot — notifier fetches directly from `risksCollection` (live data), not a snapshot
